news.title: Butler Arts Receives $1 Million Gift to Activate Rollie and Cheri Dick Arts Performance Fund
news.summary_en: Local arts organizations invited to apply for venue grants for 2027-2028 performance season  Butler University recently received a $1 million gift from Cheri Dick and her late husband Rollie Dick for its Arts Performance Fund that will accelerate efforts to expand stage access and programming opportunities for local arts organizations at Butler Arts venues.
